ModMetaData.author: mcocdaa
ModMetaData.description:
[h1]RimMind - Dialogue (v2.0)[/h1] Contextual social dialogue, native spoken ToolCalls, and overhead speech bubble system for RimWorld colonists. Powered by the structured [code]express_dialogue[/code] function-calling pipeline, colonists converse naturally during dining, work shifts, recreation, and crisis moments—dynamically shaping moods and interpersonal relationships.
[b]v2.0 Clean Architecture & RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7 Dual-Version Support:[/b] [list] [*][b]RimWorld 1.6 & 1.7 (Waylith / .NET 10) Ready[/b]: Native multi-target compilation supporting both RimWorld 1.6 (.NET Framework 4.8) and RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10 / Harmony 2.x & 3.x). [*][b]v2.0 Native [code]express_dialogue[/code] ToolCall Pipeline[/b]: Transmits spoken lines ([code]reply[/code]), inner psychological subtext ([code]thought[/code]), and relationship delta ([code]relation_delta[/code]) as structured tool calls. Note: v1.x saves are not compatible with v2.0. [*][b]Multi-Stage Anti-Pollution Sanitizer[/b]: [code]DialogueTextSanitizer[/code] strips [code]think[/code] reasoning blocks, code fences, and raw JSON fragments so overhead speech bubbles remain 100% clean and immersive. [/list]
[h2]What Is RimMind[/h2] RimMind is an enterprise-grade, AI-powered RimWorld mod suite. Integrated with Large Language Models (LLM), it transforms colonists into self-reflecting agents with distinct personalities, three-tier memories, natural spoken dialogues, autonomous mechanisms, and dynamic storytelling.

[h2]Core Features[/h2] [list] [*][b]Event-Responsive & Proximity Banter[/b] - Replaces vanilla Chitchat and DeepTalk with context-aware AI conversations when awake colonists are within 6.9 tiles during dining, crafting, or relaxation, plus monologues on injuries, skill milestones, and mood swings. [*][b]Player-Initiated Multi-Turn Chat[/b] - Start direct conversations via pawn Gizmo buttons or right-click menus with persistent session memory. [*][b]Dynamic Relationship & Thought Injection[/b] - Conversations apply real-time social opinion modifiers (-5 to +5) and inject emotional Thoughts ([i]ENCOURAGED, VALUED, CONNECTED, HURT, STRESSED, IRRITATED[/i]) that affect colonist mood and notify [code]RimMind-Advisor[/code]. [*][b]Strict Liveness & Consciousness Gating[/b] - Guarded by [code]RimMindPawnLookup[/code] so sleeping, downed, dead, imprisoned, or off-map pawns never emit ghost dialogues. [*][b]Draggable Floating Chat HUD & History Log[/b] - Real-time corner dialogue overlay with adjustable opacity, plus a categorized dual-panel conversation log window. [/list]

[h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2] [b]Q: Will dialogues slow down the game?[/b] A: No. Requests run asynchronously in the background with per-pawn and per-pair cooldowns.
[b]Q: Does it conflict with RimTalk or RimChat?[/b] A: Use [code]RimMind-Bridge-RimTalk[/code] or [code]RimMind-Bridge-RimChat[/code] for automatic mutual exclusion gating and unified bubble rendering.
